observations: A stack of approximately six solar panels leaning against a metal structure.

The panels use a half-cut cell design, indicated by the horizontal division in the middle.
Frames are made of silver-colored aluminum.
A watermark 'PRIME ELITE ENERGY' and 'POSTED ON Jiji' is overlaid on the image.
No manufacturer logos, brand names, or technical specification labels are visible on the front of the panels.

claims.evidence: The panels appear clean, but they are stored in an outdoor, dusty environment which may affect condition.
No Suntech logo or branding is visible in photo 0.
Efficiency ratings require laboratory testing or a verified datasheet linked to a specific model number.
Charging speed depends on the charge controller and battery system, not just the panel.
The dark, uniform color and cell structure in photo 0 are consistent with monocrystalline panels.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as the lowest standard wattage for this physical size (approx 300W).

risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter test of the Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) in direct sunlight.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification label on the back of the panel showing wattage and model.

response.reason: The wattage and brand are not visible in the provided photo. Solar panels are priced primarily by their power output (watts), which is found on the rear label.
